out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Moved through house (bedroom, corridor, kitchen seen through wall), later flew from ambulance to a dome-like space and to/over hospital areas while also perceiving husband and staff.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported being unable to move the physical body (frozen/heavy) while out; later felt flying at incredible speed and feeling cool air/breeze proportional to speed.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: No tunnel described; instead an 'immense dome' (light-salmon colored) and flight toward a beautiful city with repeated falling 'blocks' obstructing the path.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Controlled flight speed (accelerate/de-accelerate); later felt a turbine-like force pulling her back when her name was called.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Identified the earlier appearing man in a white tunic with a golden waist strap as 'Jesus of Nazareth'.
arrival.other_being_detail: Saw a 'big transparent being, like a jellyfish' holding the moon over its head and Earth between its feet.

environment.environment_other_detail: An 'immense dome' light-salmon colored; a 'beautiful city' in the distance becoming closer; repeated salmon/coral blocks falling in front of her path; saw the moon and Earth during return pull.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two episodes: (1) 1987 episode with paralysis/OBE and a bright light at bedroom window; (2) 2011 medical emergency treated as heart attack with later report of stent/blocked femoral artery and extensive OBE.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Included paralysis/inability to move body; repeated obstructing blocks before reaching city; authoritarian voice calling her name; 'chip' insertion sensation with turbine-like sound/energy transfer; vision of Third World War devastation.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred with paralysis and light presence; later in 2011 OBE included visions (war), then God encounter, then medical-event OBE with flight toward city and obstruction/boundary leading to forced return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple exits/returns to body (1987 and 2011; also repeatedly left body to seek help/observe).
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reported flying while simultaneously perceiving hospital actions and husband’s conversation; also perceived multiple scenes (body with staff and husband elsewhere).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Authoritarian female voice: 'We are coming, searching for you' with a beautiful light ball near bedroom window (1987). Repeated inability to descend stairs while out of body (1987). Vision of Third World War devastation and dying there (2011). Sensation of implanting a transparent 'chip' from right forearm through chest to left forearm with turbine-like sound and seismograph-like recording (2011). Salmon/coral blocks repeatedly falling to block approach to a beautiful city; huge transparent jellyfish-like being holding moon and Earth (2011).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'That's it, everything in its place.' / 'We are coming, searching for you' / 'I explained to him that I still have things to do and bang! I came back to my body in thousandths of a second.' / 'Call the ambulance, call the ambulance' / 'take away the panty hose, take away the panty hose.' / 'Yes, I have seen it'.
